units.source_text: 他从杀虫瓶里倒出虫子，想趁虫子还未僵硬之前，用大头针把它们固定好，把脚的形状对齐。

en.t: He emptied the insects out of the killing jar, hoping to pin them in place with large pins before they had stiffened, and line up the shapes of their legs.

units.source_text: 外间的水槽旁，传来女人洗碗的声音。

en.t: From beside the sink in the outer room came the sound of the woman washing dishes.

units.source_text: ……这房子里，怕是没有其他什么人住吧？

en.t: ...There probably was no one else living in this house, was there?
